auto_debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output for internal DLM operations.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging: 0 = silent, 1 = basic info, 2 = verbose, 3 = debug.

lockspace_dir.description: Directory where DLM lockspace state files are stored.

lock_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a lock acquisition before considering it failed.

netlink_socket.description: Whether to use netlink socket for kernel communication: 'yes', 'no', or 'auto' (recommended).

lockspaces.description: List of custom lockspaces to manage alongside the default cluster lockspace.

reclaim_strict.description: If true, enforce strict reclaim semantics for abandoned locks in this lockspace.

threads.description: Number of worker threads allocated to handle lock operations in this lockspace.
